tasks.title: Declare canonical vs derived in one tested place
tasks.goal: One source-level declaration: canonical = the five JSONL stores + events/ + captures (+ registry snapshots); derived = every query/query_v2 return type. A test asserts the declaration matches the stores durable_run_view actually reads.
deliveredBehaviors: The split is declared and tested, not folklore
